null-fields: You must fill out all fields

click-deny-if-confused: IF YOU DON'T UNDERSTAND THEN CLICK DENY
not-customer: You cannot access this page unless you have purchased something from our [store].
email-not-verified: Your email could not be verified.
email-verified: You have successfully verified your email!
if-sent-then-error: If you were sent here by the website then some error has occured. Please contact admin at
invalid-oauth-message: The website that redirected you here didn't provide the required information for us to authenticate them. Or the client id they specified is invalid. You should report this to the website owner.
browser-not-redirecting: Is your browser not redirecting you? [Click here]
wait-while-login: Please wait while we log you in
services-cost-money: Unfortunately some services Serble operates cost money to run, this is why we have to impose usage limits on some things. We pride ourselves on being mostly a free service run as a hobby, but we also want to keep the lights on.
sub-will-help-us: Purchasing a subscription will help support Serble and allow us to continue to provide you with the best service possible. This service costs money to run, and we need your help to keep it going, so we would greatly appreciate it if you would consider purchasing a subscription.
welcome-to-serble: Welcome to Serble! Serble is a collection of services, most of which I have created. Not all the projects are publicly available, but you can find them all here. I would like to increase the number of projects that are available to the public, so if you have any suggestions for new projects, or any feedback, please contact me through [one of these methods].
looking-for-mc-server: Looking for the old Minecraft server website? [Go here]
sorry-not-found: Sorry, there's nothing here, you could try another URL or go to our [home page]. Or you could look at this picture of a cat:
swift-description: SWIFT is a user-inclusive browser extension created by 4 entrepreneurs. After weeks of deliberation and creating, SWIFT was developed. A free browser extension that allows user to vote on whether a domain is trustworthy or flag them as suspicious. With both a free and paid model, SWIFT is inclusive to all kinds of users, from those who just want the bare minimum for free, to those who want the full experience at a very fair price.
setup-totp-instructions: On your chosen TOTP app (Some apps you could use include Authy, Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator) scan the QR code below and setup your account. Once you have setup your account, enter the code it provides you into the box to the right and click submit.
totp-warning: If you proceed to setup up 2FA then you will be required to enter a code from your TOTP app every time you login. If you lose access to your TOTP app then you will lose access to your account.
no-authorized-apps: You haven't authorized any applications yet.
redirecting-to-portal: Taking you to the payment portal, please wait.
not-customer-pre: You haven't purchased anything from our
not-customer-post: yet. Once you do, you can manage your payments here.
official-app-tooltip: This is an official first-party Serble application.
send-coins-subtitle: Transfer coins to another user by their username or ID.
sensitive-scope-warning: I understand this application is requesting sensitive permissions that could be dangerous, and I trust it.
inventory-subtitle: Items you own, granted or traded through Serble apps.
inventory-empty-text: Items you receive from apps will show up here.
my-apps-subtitle: Manage the applications you've created and their credentials.
no-apps-subtitle: Create your first application to get started.
credentials-subtitle: Your application identifies itself to Serble with these.
client-secret-hint: Keep your client secret private. Never include it in front-end code or a public repository.
copy-failed: Copy failed — select and copy manually.
app-details-subtitle: Shown to users when they're asked to authorize your application.
description-hint: Optional. Shown to users when they authorize your app.
redirect-uris-hint: Optional. URIs users can be redirected to after authorization. Press Enter or click Add.
api-keys-subtitle: Keys let your app authenticate as itself using the header
key-name-too-long: Key name must be 128 characters or fewer.
revoke-key-confirm: Revoke this key? Apps using it stop working.
copy-key-warning: Copy this key now — it will never be shown again.
delete-app-warning: Permanently deletes this application. Anyone signed in through it loses access immediately and its API keys stop working.
delete-app-failed: Couldn't delete the application. Please try again.
move-coins-subtitle: Move coins between your balance and this application's.
deposit-hint: Coins leave your balance and arrive in the application's.
withdraw-hint: Coins leave the application's balance and arrive in yours.
enter-amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
enter-amount-zero-or-more: Enter an amount of zero or more.
transfer-failed: Couldn't move the coins. Please try again.
withdraw-success: Coins moved out of the application.
target-balance-subtitle: The balance the tax system tops this official application up to.
target-balance-hint: Administrators only. Set it to zero to turn the top-up off.
save-target-failed: Couldn't save the target balance. Please try again.
new-app-subtitle: Fill in the details for your new application.
authorized-apps-subtitle: Applications you've granted access to your Serble account.
authorized-apps-empty-sub: When you authorize an application, it will appear here.
scope-full_access-desc: Allows full access to the account.
scope-user_info-desc: Allows access to the account's information (Eg. Username, Email).
scope-payment_info-desc: Allows access to a user's list of purchased products and allows them to manage their subscriptions, including viewing the last 4 digits of their credit card and viewing purchase history.
scope-manage_account-desc: Grants the ability to control the user's account, including changing their email, and username. Only you can change your password.
scope-manage_apps-desc: Allows management over all of your OAuth application, this does not allow the authorization of apps.
scope-vault-desc: Allows access to the user's vault, including read and write access.
scope-economy-desc: Allows reading the account's coin balance and transaction history.
scope-manage_economy-desc: Allows modifying the account's coin balance without consent, such as transferring coins out.
webhooks-subtitle: Signed HTTP POSTs when the economy touches this app's balance. If you hold coins on behalf of your own users, subscribe to {event} so you can pass the tax on to them instead of absorbing it.
webhook-secret-warning: Copy this signing secret now — it will {never} be shown again. Losing it means rotating it.
webhook-signature-hint: Verify each request with {hmac}, hex, and compare it to the {header} header.
endpoint-url-hint: Must be HTTPS and publicly resolvable.
webhook-auto-disabled: Auto-disabled: {reason} Re-enable it below once the endpoint is fixed.
deliveries-empty: Nothing loaded. Use Load to fetch what has been sent to this endpoint.
event-tax.collected-desc: A tax cycle charged this app's balance. Pass the rate on to any coins you hold for your users.
event-tax.payout-desc: A tax cycle topped this app's balance back up toward its target.
webhook-url-required: Enter the URL events should be sent to.
webhook-select-event: Select at least one event type.
webhook-disabled-msg: Webhook disabled — nothing new will be queued for it.
webhook-rotate-confirm: Issue a new signing secret? The current one stops verifying immediately, so your endpoint will reject events until you deploy the new secret.
webhook-enable-before-test: Enable the webhook before testing it.
webhook-test-failed: Failed to queue a test event.
webhook-test-queued: Test event queued. It is sent within a few seconds — reload the delivery log to see the result.
webhook-delete-confirm: Delete the webhook for {url}? Anything still queued for it is dropped.
oauth-err-missing-params: One or more required query parameters are missing.
oauth-err-app-not-found: No application with the given client_id was found.
oauth-err-redirect-uri-mismatch: The redirect_uri does not match any of the URIs registered for this application.
oauth-err-bad-app: The application ID was rejected by the server.
oidc-warning: {app} wants to sign you in with your Serble account. Only approve if you trust this application.
oidc-deny-hint: If you didn't initiate this sign-in, click Deny.
oidc-err-no-session: No consent session id was provided in the URL.
oidc-err-expired: This consent request has expired or is invalid. Please retry signing in from the application.
oidc-err-unauthenticated: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
oidc-err-forbidden: You are not allowed to use this application.
oidc-err-unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
oidc-detail-no-redirect: Server did not return a redirect URL.
oidc-scope-openid: Sign you in to this application
oidc-scope-groups: See which groups you are a member of
oidc-scope-offline_access: Stay signed in when you are away
